_comment: Copy to apps.json, or just run 'install' and it will be created for you. One entry per sideloaded app. Everything here can be inferred by 'install <url>' - these examples exist to document the shape and the optional fields.

apps.name: USB Device Tree Viewer
apps.notes: The download URL carries no version, so versionPattern is hand-written rather than derived.

apps._optionalFields: Any entry may also carry these.
apps.name: Example App
apps.hold: why this app is never updated automatically
apps.notes: exe pins which executable is used for version detection and the Platform menu key. preserve lists folders to carry across an update, overriding the Scoop manifest's persist. hold may be true or a reason string: the app is still checked and reported, but never updated without -Force - use it when upstream tracks a different edition than the one you run. selfManaged is for apps with their own updater: 'update' still reports new releases but never offers to install them (also without -Force); after the app updates itself, run 'bump <id> [version]' to record its new version in .sideload.json without downloading anything.
